reason: A DeepSeek Harness web GUI plugin for browsing registered workspace files and editing them in a VS Code-style dual-pane interface, with local file read, write, create, and rename operations.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供类似 VS Code 的双栏工作区文件浏览器和编辑器，支持查看、创建、重命名及保存文件。
summaries.en: Adds a VS Code-style dual-pane workspace file explorer and editor to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, with file viewing, creation, renaming, and saving.

capabilities: Lists registered workspace directories and files
Writes edited file contents to disk
Provides a local HTTP API for workspace file operations
Displays text previews and lightweight syntax highlighting
Opens files with the system default application
